title: Bus advertisement

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Simplify a message for a moving surface, because passing viewers have little time to read.
strategic_value: The large beetle beside a brief invitation can make the Museum’s offer recognizable in street traffic.
demonstration: A red double-decker bus carries a cyan strip reading Book a day out of the ordinary with a museum signature and an oversized beetle.
practical_value: Compare a short horizontal message with a specimen that extends beyond the strip.

content_islands.name: Message strip
content_islands.spec: Run the cyan headline strip along the bus side and place the museum signature at its right end.

content_islands.name: Oversized specimen
content_islands.spec: Extend the beetle vertically across the strip and red bus body.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Retain the bus and surrounding buildings to show viewing distance.

reference_purposes.Application: A red double-decker bus carries a cyan strip reading Book a day out of the ordinary with a museum signature and an oversized beetle.
